title: Contains duplicate
summary: Return true if any value appears at least twice in `nums`.
hints: By hand, how do you notice a repeat in a long list? What do you keep track of as you read?
Keep a collection of the values you have already passed. For each new value, check the collection before adding to it.
A set gives a one-step "have I seen this?" check. Without a set (as in C), sort the array first so that duplicates end up next to each other.
takeaway: A set makes this O(n). Sorting first is O(n log n) and needs no extra structure, which is the usual route in C.
